retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1990s urban comedy layout featuring exaggerated character photography flanking oversized, blocky, hand-drawn display type on a vibrant yellow radial gradient.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring two full-body character portraits on the left and right edges, framing a massive, multi-layered typographic stack in the center. The background is a bright yellow with a subtle white radial glow, creating a spotlight effect that pushes the subjects forward.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters act as vertical bookends for the central text
Primary red and yellow color palette creates high-energy urgency
Exaggerated character silhouettes contrast with rigid block lettering
Hand-drawn subtitle text provides a loose, graffiti-inspired counterpoint to the heavy main title
coreInvariants: Vibrant yellow background with center-out radial glow
Heavy black outlines on all typographic elements
Red-fill main title with yellow secondary outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures at 100% vertical height on the left and right margins, facing inward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, vertically stacked red title text in the center-top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central red title, moves down to the secondary script text, then outward to the character expressions.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures and large-scale type.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors with high-value background to ensure foreground pop.
paletteRestrictions: Primary focus on Red, Yellow, and Black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif with geometric, angular modifications
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent baseline for a 'jittery' energetic feel
Internal red fill with a secondary yellow inline or outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'O' and 'D' are squared off with sharp corners
Vertical stems are elongated to fill vertical space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric block type paired with loose, organic marker-style script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows on characters to anchor them to the floor

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for the main title.
Captures the loose, energetic feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright yellow background with a soft white radial glow in the center. Place two full-body characters on the far left and right, facing the center. The left character should be in casual 90s streetwear, the right character should have an exaggerated, comedic appearance with eccentric hair and clothing. Leave a large vertical gap in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive, vertically stacked block lettering in the center gap using a bright red fill and thick black outlines. Below this, add a multi-line subtitle in a hand-drawn yellow marker style with black outlines, slightly arched.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant yellow radial gradient?
Are the characters positioned as bookends on the edges?
Is the central text massive and red with heavy black outlines?
Is the secondary text in a loose, hand-drawn style?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the red and yellow
Degree of 'jitter' in the hand-drawn lettering
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap character faces
Verify the yellow background is not too pale
Check that the black outlines are thick and consistent
Confirm the central text is the largest element
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Two Exaggerated Characters] + [Vibrant Yellow Radial Background] + [Massive Red Block Type with Black Outlines] + [Yellow Marker Script Subtitle].
